eps.o: TNA iMPACT! is loaded on the first episode of 2026. Frankie Kazarian defends the TNA World Title against newcomer Bear Bronson. The Angel Warriors battle The Elegance Brand. Mustafa Ali takes on The Home Town Man.
Tensions rise on TNA iMPACT! as a new era approaches. Frankie Kazarian and Mike Santana meet face-to-face for an official TNA World Championship contract signing.

It's the beginning of a historic new era for TNA Wrestling as Thursday Night iMPACT! debuts on AMC. Frankie Kazarian defends the TNA World Championship against Mike Santana. AJ Styles makes his phenomenal return.

From Albuquerque, New Mexico, TNA World Tag Team Champion Jeff Hardy goes one-on-one with Mustafa Ali. The stakes are high in the return of Feast or Fired. We will hear from TNA's newest Knockout, Elayna Black.

The fallout from last week’s chaos sends shockwaves through TNA. The night is headlined by a No Holds Barred war as AJ Francis collides with Rich Swann in a match with no rules, no mercy, and no turning back.
Knockouts trios match as Xia Brookside, Lei Ying Lee, and Indi Hartwell face The Elegance Brand in Ash By Elegance's first match back in months.

In the explosive main event, The System collide with Mike Santana, The Hardys, and Moose in a star-studded 8-man showdown. With championship implications looming and bad blood on all sides, this match promises chaos.
Elijah faces Mustafa Ali in a Guitar Case Casket Match! Will Elijah put Ali's campaign to rest?

The Hardys & The Righteous collide with The System in a blockbuster showdown. Plus, Mike Santana & Leon Slater battle the Nemeths, and Mickie James goes face-to-face with Ash By Elegance in the iMPACT Zone!
TNA iMPACT emanates from Atlanta, GA with can't-miss action, including Leon Slater defending the X-Division Championship against "The Wanted Man" Nic Nemeth for the first time ever!
Cedric Alexander and Moose collide in an Atlanta Street Fight! The Hardys battle Sinner & Saint, Mustafa Ali returns to action, Maclin marches toward the TNA World Title, and Elijah faces AJ Francis!

From Atlanta, the road to Sacrifice continues! Angel Warriors face Dani Luna & champion Arianna Grace. Moose battles Brian Myers, Elayna Black faces Jada Stone, and The Righteous clash with The Nemeths!
Jeff Hardy faces Brian Myers, Mustafa Ali faces BDE, plus Bear Bronson & Moose collide.
